beats.say: Nintendo is older than the airplane.
It was started in 1889, in Kyoto, Japan.
And it made playing cards, called hanafuda.
Later, Nintendo tried running a taxi company…
…selling instant rice… and even a vacuum cleaner.
Then an engineer built a toy grabbing arm, the Ultra Hand. It sold over a million.
That led to video games, and eventually, to Mario.
And Nintendo still sells playing cards today.
